name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx with three static HTTPS virtual hosts, development certificates, security headers, request controls, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl hardening.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, log directory management, service enablement, and a compatibility workaround for generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment, provisions its database and user, and runs it as a systemd service.
